testcase.name: save preserves exact line endings and produces no orphaned temp file
list sorts folders first shows git badges and protects metadata
symlinks inside and outside the tree are excluded and cannot be followed
paths cannot escape the repository or target git metadata
creation and rename never overwrite existing content
save refuses external modifications and preserves both the original draft and newer file
binary invalid UTF8 and large files use readonly fallback
nested file create save rename delete cycle produces real working tree changes
delete refuses a file that changed since opening
